notes.title: Non-Scary Hardcore Horror Game "Happy Chase" Released！
notes.content:
Happy Halloween! We've released the truly terrifying horror game "Happy Chase." Control the Grim Reaper and harvest souls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245488/1684194446276dd2bfd5bfa9a0eddb6f380b1ddf.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=kforF3etarU;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in a dimly lit mansion, the game has you searching for human targets, capturing them with a scythe and special skills in this simple first-person perspective game.

[h1]The Fear Comes from Yourself[/h1]
"Happy Chase" is a hardcore first-person horror game. Typically, in horror games, you're the one running away, but this game was created with the goal of breaking that convention. Here, you become the object of fear, chasing after human souls trying to escape. In dark rooms, wielding a giant scythe… Enjoy creating the fear yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245488/96a69d5c6f36dcda0cfddfd2313d7b1dff887e70.png[/img]

[h1]Two Playable Modes[/h1]
The game offers two modes: Normal Mode, where the difficulty increases with each level, and 1 Minute Mode, where you collect as many souls as possible within a one-minute time limit.
[h2]Normal Mode[/h2]
There are 13 difficulty levels, and you must collect a specified number of souls in each level. Use special skills to slow down your enemies and wield your scythe to capture souls. With no game over or time limits, you can play at your own pace and fully savor the satisfaction of being in control!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245488/7062d2fa81bc987336475c9f4fc099aae095b155.png[/img]
[h2]1 Minute Mode[/h2]
Unlike Normal Mode, your special skill boosts your movement speed. There's no limit to the number of souls to collect, and no quotas! Enjoy the thrill of swift, exhilarating movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245488/396db24a7a5bbb7b69c3d5bd6436fcb617ad5b91.png[/img]
